text:
peter-sales: Quick sync — Labyrinth Therapeutics signed an LOI and wants a 2-week POC next month. They need a custom Llama-variant (70B fine-tuned) to run in our Dedicated offering. Main asks: variant compatibility, KV cache persistence across restarts for 1M token conversations, EU data residency, KMS integration, and a rough cost estimate for ~100k tokens/day with p50 ~200ms. Who can triage what we can commit for the POC?

lia-ml: Congrats! I'm happy to own model-compat checks. Quick Q: is the variant using a custom tokenizer or standard llama tokenizer? tokenization differences are the usual gotcha.

peter-sales: Good point — customer said "minimal tokenizer tweaks" but will send their model card tonight.

rob-infra: For Dedicated we can host the variant, but for 70B we need either 8xA100-80GB or quantized with Triton-style kernels. KV cache persistence: we have two options — checkpoint KV shards to persistent volume at checkpoints, or use a small fast object-store (S3/GCS) for KV snapshot+restore on restart. The former keeps latency tighter.

lia-ml: If they can do q4_k_m or int8 quant, we reduce memory and can likely keep everything on fewer GPUs. Need to confirm weight format (hf-llama, safetensors, or custom). Also: we should validate KV layout (per-token key shape) — some variants change KV dtype/ordering.

sarah-se: On security: they require EU-only residency and company-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault). We'll need Private or Dedicated in EU region with KMS integration. Also legal asked for a DSAR and DPA template; I can prep those but need the customer's privacy contact.

devin-eng: From an SLA/rollout perspective: 2-week POC — we can do a canary in Dedicated with traffic steering to a fallback open 13B for failover. Don't promise 99.9% unless they take dedicated reserved nodes. For the POC we can commit to best-effort latency targets with an ops playbook.

peter-sales: Sounds reasonable. Customer wants an answer by EOD Friday so they can finalize the schedule. Can we get a quick sketch of costs and blockers?

lia-ml: I'll run a compatibility pass once they drop the model card. Meanwhile I can stub tests: tokenizer roundtrip, sample generation, kv-restore simulation. Should have initial results in 48h.

rob-infra: Cost sketch (very rough): Dedicated nodes vs quantized dedicated. Example calc:
```
Option A - Full FP16 (8xA100-80GB reserved): infra ~ $18k/mo, estimated POC 2-week prorate ~$4.5k + setup ops time
Option B - Quantized int8 / q4_k_m on 4xA100 or 4xA30: infra ~ $9k/mo, POC prorate ~$2.2k
Token cost (infra amortized) at 100k tokens/day (~3M tokens/mo): incremental infra cost per 1M tokens ~ $2-3 depending on batching.
```
These are infra-only, exclude engineering/SE time for onboarding, legal, and KMS work.

sarah-se: Add on the compliance uplift: EU KMS + DPA + audit logs — expect ~2-3 engineer-days to wire KMS & validate. Also will need an ISO/ SOC request window if they ask.

devin-eng: Ops overhead: create a canary route, fallback policy, KV checkpoint schedule, and runbook. I estimate 3-4 eng-days across infra/ops to get a repeatable POC. If we do persist KV to PV, we need storage IOPS sizing — I'll own that.

peter-sales: Helpful — can we make a conservative commitment to: (1) run the variant on Dedicated EU with checkpointed KV to PV, (2) integrate Azure Key Vault via our KMS plugin, (3) provide cost estimate and runbook? Customer needs signoff by Friday.

rob-infra: Yes, contingent on weight format being compatible and model quantizing cleanly. If they require nonstandard attention kernels, that adds time.

lia-ml: Also will need a representative prompt suite from the customer to validate quality post-quant and after checkpoint/restore. Ask them for 50-100 prompts and expected behaviors.

peter-sales: I'll request model card, tokenizer details, and prompt suite tonight.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] New POC project created: project/labyrinth-poc. Assigned tags: dedicated, EU, kms. Ticket: #POC-8421.

sarah-se: I'll start DPA template and ask for privacy contact. If they need encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys, confirm scope (model weights vs request logs).

devin-eng: Next steps & owners:
- lia-ml: model compatibility tests (48h)
- rob-infra: infra sizing + PV vs object-store decision + cost sketch (tomorrow)
- sarah-se: DPA & security checklist + KMS preflight (tomorrow)
- peter-sales: gather model card, tokenizer, prompt suite (EOD)
- devin-eng: ops runbook/canary plan (48-72h)

lia-ml: I'll post a short compatibility checklist in the thread once I start.

peter-sales: Thanks — I'll ping them for the artifacts. If anyone needs a call with the customer's ML lead, say so and I'll book a 30m slot.

rob-infra: One more note — if they insist on on-prem private deployment (air-gapped) that's a different scoping entirely. Clarify POC target: Dedicated (our managed infra) vs Private (customer infra).

peter-sales: Customer prefers our Dedicated in EU for speed; will flag if Private becomes required.

sarah-se: ok. I'll drop a short CSV of required security items once I get the privacy contact.

lia-ml: ack. Starting compatibility pass after the model card arrives.

peter-sales: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update thread when I have artifacts. :thumbsup:
